strings.IGD（到真前沿的平均距离，越小越好）: IGD (mean distance to the true front, smaller is better)
strings.超体积占真前沿的比例（越大越好）: Hypervolume as a fraction of the true front's (larger is better)
strings.这些函数的真前沿有解析式，所以两个指标都有绝对意义：IGD 同时惩罚「没收敛」和: These functions have analytic true fronts, so both indicators have absolute meaning: IGD penalises both “not converged” and “not spread out”; the HV reference point is fixed per function and does not depend on the results (mostly 1.1 per objective; 0.6 for DTLZ1; (32, 11) for ZDT5; (1.1, 1.1, 7) for DTLZ7). The curve shows the best-so-far IGD.
strings.纯前端实时计算（2D/3D），不改 worker 协议；本合成实例无解析真前沿，: Computed live in the front end (2D/3D) without changing the worker protocol; this synthetic instance has no analytic true front, so IGD does not apply and only HV is reported.
strings.UKP 是 BKP 的特例：取有效上界 cᵢ=⌊C/wᵢ⌋ 即退化为有界背包: UKP is a special case of BKP: take the effective bound cᵢ = ⌊C/wᵢ⌋ and it reduces to bounded knapsack
strings.位向量（每点一位 = 选 / 不选）: Bit vector (one bit per vertex = chosen / not chosen)
strings.排列前 p 位=设施: First p entries of the permutation = facilities
strings.找零是 UKP 的目标-约束对调取等：最大化已选硬币总价值 ⇔ 最小化凑足金额: Change-making is UKP with objective and constraint swapped: maximising the total value of the chosen coins ⇔ minimising the number of coins that make the amount C
strings.0-1 背包是分数背包的特例（每件只许取 0 或 1）：可行域收窄成离散选择，精: 0-1 knapsack is a special case of fractional knapsack (each item may only be taken 0 or 1 times): the feasible region narrows to discrete choices and the exact problem returns to the NP-hard regime. In plain words: fractional is the relaxed version, 0-1 the tightened one
strings.0/1 位串编码：选中的顶点互不相邻即合法（绿=选中）；目标=独立集最大。度升序: 0/1 bit-string encoding: a set of chosen vertices with no two adjacent is valid (green = chosen); objective = largest independent set. Ascending-degree greedy serves as the anchor

strings.{n} 点有向容量费用网: {n}-node directed network with capacities and costs
strings.{n} 顶点 · p=0.5（每顶点删 1-2 候选色）: {n} vertices · p = 0.5 (1–2 candidate colours removed per vertex)
strings.{n} 顶点 · p=0.5（顶点与边同调色板）: {n} vertices · p = 0.5 (vertices and edges share one palette)
strings.{n} 个块 · 约 {n} 对希望相邻: {n} blocks · about {n} pairs that should be adjacent

strings.MCKP 的 LP 松弛至多一个分数变量，整数核即 0-1 KP；归约即证 NP: The LP relaxation of MCKP has at most one fractional variable and its integer core is a 0-1 KP; the reduction proves NP-hardness

strings.NP-hard（含 CVRP 为特例）: NP-hard (contains CVRP as a special case)

strings.SAT=目标全满足的特例: SAT = the special case where all clauses must be satisfied
strings.SP 好求 vs TSP 难: SP is easy, TSP is hard

strings.一维下料 = 一维装箱：棒材=箱子，零件=物品，目标=最少棒材: One-dimensional cutting = one-dimensional bin packing: rod = bin, piece = item, goal = fewest rods
strings.一行点：解 = 顶点的排列；绿弧 = 从左指向右（满足），红弧 = 指回左边（违: A row of nodes: solution = a permutation of the vertices; green arcs = left to right (satisfied), red arcs = pointing back left (violated; objective = number of red arcs); Kahn's algorithm reaches 0 in linear time — a problem in P
strings.三个目标用斜投影画出（点色 = 目标3）；淡点 = 解析真前沿，圈 = 当前非支: The three objectives are drawn with an oblique projection (point colour = objective 3); faint points = analytic true front, circles = current non-dominated solutions
strings.三个资源维度（各有独立的重量与容量）同时约束：柱=物品（高度=第一维重量）亮=选: Three resource dimensions (each with its own weights and capacity) constrain at once: bar = item (height = first-dimension weight), lit = chosen
strings.上：每辆车一种颜色的路线；下：时间轴——浅色条 = 客户的时间窗，深色块 = 服: Top: one colour of route per vehicle; bottom: timeline — light bar = customer time window, dark block = service period, thin line = waiting after early arrival
strings.与标准定义的差异：每条边的行走方向由「先到近的一端」的贪心定，不是搜索出来的；路: Difference from the standard definition: the direction in which each edge is traversed is set greedily (nearer end first), not searched; the order within a route is the permutation order, with no within-route optimisation
strings.与标准定义的差异：Rastrigin + 一条线性约束的自拟函数，不是标准约束基: Difference from the standard definition: a self-made function (Rastrigin + one linear constraint), not a standard constrained benchmark such as the CEC constrained suite
strings.与标准定义的差异：Rastrigin 地形，目标仍是单一全局最优；没有「同时定位: Difference from the standard definition: a Rastrigin landscape whose goal is still a single global optimum; there is no evaluation of locating several peaks at once
strings.与标准定义的差异：「噪声」是确定性伪噪声（同输入同输出），不是真随机噪声: Difference from the standard definition: the “noise” is deterministic pseudo-noise (same input, same output), not real random noise
strings.与标准定义的差异：上层 Rastrigin + 下层最优响应耦合项的自拟函数，没: Difference from the standard definition: a self-made function coupling an upper-level Rastrigin with a lower-level best-response term; there is no genuine nested optimisation
strings.与标准定义的差异：二维方格 HP 模型 + 绝对方向编码；自交用罚分（每处 4）: Difference from the standard definition: 2D square-lattice HP model with absolute-direction encoding; self-intersections are penalised (4 each) rather than excluded; the sequences are random (45% H), not the standard sequences of the literature
strings.与标准定义的差异：仓库个数固定为 2；客户归最近仓库、按排列顺序装车（不优化每辆: Difference from the standard definition: the number of depots is fixed at 2; customers go to the nearest depot and are loaded in permutation order (route order within a vehicle is not optimised); depots have no capacity
strings.与标准定义的差异：函数是标准的 Rosenbrock，但只有 10 维，并非真正: Difference from the standard definition: the function is the standard Rosenbrock but only 10-dimensional, not truly large scale (usually ≥ 1000 dimensions)
strings.与标准定义的差异：取模赋值 + 冲突罚，规模与约束类型有限: Difference from the standard definition: modulo assignment + conflict penalty, with limited size and constraint types
strings.与标准定义的差异：只是把迭代数限到 50 代来「模拟」昂贵评估；没有代理模型，也: Difference from the standard definition: ‘expensive’ evaluation is only simulated by limiting the run to 50 generations; there is no surrogate model and no evaluation-budget counting
strings.与标准定义的差异：只有 3 条合成的短 DNA 序列、线性空位罚分（匹配 +2、: Difference from the standard definition: only 3 short synthetic DNA sequences and a linear gap penalty (match +2, mismatch −1, residue against gap −2), no BLOSUM-type substitution matrices or affine gaps; the decoder repairs the bit string by appending residues when there are not enough 1s
strings.与标准定义的差异：只有「互不重叠」与「希望相邻」两类规则的圆形块布局，没有采光、: Difference from the standard definition: only two rules (no overlap, wish to be adjacent) for circular blocks, with no daylight, circulation or structural criteria; the design space is just 2k coordinates
strings.与标准定义的差异：只要求需求点对连通（斯坦纳森林），没有流量、容量，也没有「固定: Difference from the standard definition: it only requires demand pairs to be connected (a Steiner forest), with no flows, capacities or two-part ‘fixed + unit’ cost
strings.与标准定义的差异：场景是 {n} 个固定的随机扰动，没有区间不确定集的凸对偶化，: Difference from the standard definition: the scenarios are {n} fixed random perturbations, with no convex-duality reformulation of interval uncertainty sets and no ‘budgeted uncertainty’ (Bertsimas–Sim); the objective is the artificial Rastrigin landscape
strings.与标准定义的差异：对阵完整性放松成大权重软罚；文献里的旅行锦标赛（Easton: Difference from the standard definition: pairing completeness is relaxed into a heavily weighted soft penalty; the travelling tournament in the literature (Easton & Nemhauser) treats it as a hard constraint
strings.与标准定义的差异：对阵完整性（双循环里每对恰好遇到两次）放松成软约束；文献里它是: Difference from the standard definition: pairing completeness (every pair meets exactly twice in a double round-robin) is relaxed into a soft constraint; in the literature it is hard
strings.与标准定义的差异：开设顺序由排列给出、开到容量够为止，客户用贪心而不是运输问题派: Difference from the standard definition: the opening order comes from the permutation until capacity suffices, and clients are assigned greedily rather than by a transportation problem; fixed and transport costs use self-chosen scales
strings.与标准定义的差异：技能分级用「偏好违约」近似；约束只有覆盖缺口、偏好、连班，没有: Difference from the standard definition: skill levels are approximated by ‘preference violations’; the constraints are only coverage gaps, preferences and streaks, without the contract rules of the INRC competitions
strings.与标准定义的差异：机器不是搜索出来的：每道工序固定挑「做完最早」的机器（常见的解: Difference from the standard definition: machines are not searched: each operation always takes the machine that finishes it earliest (a common decoding rule, but it misses optima that require deliberately choosing a slower machine)
strings.与标准定义的差异：目标函数由你自己给出：结果只对你写的公式成立，本站不替它的含义: Difference from the standard definition: you supply the objective function: results hold only for the formula you wrote, and this site takes no responsibility for its meaning
strings.与标准定义的差异：考试与学生选课来自随机冲突图（每个学生恰选两门，保证存在零冲突: Difference from the standard definition: exams and enrolments come from a random conflict graph (each student takes exactly two, guaranteeing a zero-conflict solution), not the Carter benchmark; hard constraints use heavily weighted penalties, and adjacent slots and room capacity are soft
strings.与标准定义的差异：贪心装配而不是对时段 × 教室做搜索；只有教师 / 课程组冲突: Difference from the standard definition: greedy assembly instead of searching over slots × rooms; only three kinds of constraint (teacher / course-group conflicts, room capacity, same-day spreading), without ITC-2007's minimum working days, timetable compactness and so on
strings.与标准定义的差异：静态双峰（按 x[0] 的符号选地形），目标并不随时间变化: Difference from the standard definition: a static two-basin function (terrain chosen by the sign of x[0]); the objective does not change over time
strings.与标准定义的差异：频率数固定为 6，相邻频率也算冲突；不是通用频率分配: Difference from the standard definition: the number of frequencies is fixed at 6 and adjacent frequencies also conflict; this is not general frequency assignment
strings.与硬窗的区别 晚到可以，但要付罚金: Difference from hard windows: arriving late is allowed, at a penalty
strings.二维方格 HP 链：实心红 = 疏水（H），空心 = 亲水（P），蓝虚线 = H: 2D square-lattice HP chain: solid red = hydrophobic (H), hollow = hydrophilic (P), blue dashed = H–H topological contacts; objective = −contacts + 4 × self-intersections
strings.二进制拆分：物品 i 拆成 ⌊log cᵢ⌋+1 捆（1,2,4,…,cᵢ−2^: Binary splitting: item i is split into ⌊log cᵢ⌋ + 1 bundles (1, 2, 4, …, cᵢ − 2^k + 1 pieces), turning BKP into 0-1 KP
strings.亮方块=取 1 的比特，目标=能量 x'Qx 最小: Lit squares = bits set to 1; objective = minimise the energy x′Qx
strings.位向量（每个元素一位 = 选 / 不选）: Bit vector (one bit per element = chosen / not chosen)
strings.位向量（每个点一位 = 在哪一侧）: Bit vector (one bit per vertex = which side)
strings.位向量（每个集合一位 = 选 / 不选）: Bit vector (one bit per set = chosen / not chosen)
strings.位向量（每个非必需点一位 = 要不要当中转点）: Bit vector (one bit per non-required point = use as relay or not)
strings.位向量（每点一位 = 删 / 不删）: Bit vector (one bit per vertex = removed / kept)
